_comment: Common generic (SAE J2012) OBD-II codes: [definition, severity]. severity: low = not urgent, medium = fix soon, high = risk of damage or danger, stop driving soon. Families like misfire cylinder N (P0301-P0312) are handled in code. Edit freely.

P0017: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor B)
